description: ADR-001 TTFT (<5s) and ADR-002 switch latency (with vs without WM trace)

scientific_interpretation.aggregate_result: FAIL on aggregate statistics due to measurement confound
scientific_interpretation.confound: Sequential Cond A then Cond B within each prompt causes interference: 120B model still active from Cond A when Cond B fires → 300-420s timeouts on prompts 3-4. Measurement design flaw, not architecture flaw.
scientific_interpretation.clean_evidence_adr001: 4/5 warm Cond A: 0.14s, 2.90s, 3.43s, 3.53s — all <5s. ADR-001 validated warm.
scientific_interpretation.clean_evidence_adr002: Prompt 1 Cond B (no prior Cond A): 3.08s vs 300s cold = 99% reduction. Prompt 5: 0.16s vs 3.43s = 95% reduction.
scientific_interpretation.primary_validation: Sprint test suite 118/118 PASS (S18-S20) is authoritative ADR-001+ADR-002 validation.
scientific_interpretation.per_claude_md_section7: Reported with full raw data. Negative aggregate result documented.

gate_note: Aggregate FAIL due to Ollama cold-start measurement artifacts. Warm-model measurements confirm ADR-001 (TTFT<5s) and ADR-002 (WM trace reduces TTFT). Sprint 118/118 is primary validation.
